Comments:
-Layout (10 points): The header, results-count strip, and left filter sidebar are in roughly the right positions. However, the large product-results area is entirely blank, unlike the reference’s dense five-column product grid. (4/10)
-Elements (15 points): Amazon navigation, sorting control, department links, and several filter controls are present. The product cards, images, ratings, prices, delivery details, and cart buttons are all missing. (5/15)
-Content and Text (40 points): Some navigation and filter text matches, but none of the product listings or their key information from the reference appear. Filter order also differs slightly. (7/40)
-Style (15 points): The dark Amazon header, white background, and basic typography are similar. The empty results area makes the page look substantially unlike the reference, and some header details are simplified. (9/15)
-Overall (20 points): The page captures the broad header-and-sidebar structure but omits the main purpose of the page: the product results. (4/20)

Score: 29/100
